briefings.title: SEC Chair Paul Atkins testifies on oversight of the Securities and Exchange Commission — 2/12/26
briefings.tldr: SEC Chair Paul Atkins signaled a fundamental shift in agency philosophy from "regulation by enforcement" to a growth-oriented framework focused on clear rule-making for digital assets, reducing the cost of public disclosures, and revitalizing the American IPO market.

briefings.title: WATCH LIVE: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins Testifies Before Senate Banking Committee
briefings.tldr: Chairman Paul Atkins is pivoting the SEC toward a pro-growth, "common sense" regulatory framework that prioritizes legislative clarity for digital assets and IPO reform, while facing sharp Democratic criticism over a significant decline in enforcement penalties and the dismissal of cases against high-profile firms.
